searchText: Hello EF merge team. I have wonder about execution api specification. within the execution-api spec, there's a interop edition. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/interop/specification.md Anyone could guide me what is this spec for? is it deprecated one? or using this spec inside of CL client? That's the old specification from the interop event So its deprecated The new one is here https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md <@!425572898787426305> <@!360491619402776577> thank you for letting me know!
